29a4b320ba3c.sentence: For some reason, pelycosaurs were able to reach larger sizes before reptiles could, and this trend continued until the end of the Permian, during which their cynodont descendants became smaller and nocturnal, as the reptilian archosaurs took over, although dicynodonts would remain megafaunal until their extinction at the end of the Triassic.

c22b6ce7b765.title: Triassic
c22b6ce7b765.sentence: However, both phytosaurs and aetosaurs were among the groups of archosaur reptiles completely wiped out by the end-Triassic extinction event.

c958e560d795.title: Triassic
c958e560d795.sentence: Phytosaurs, the most common fossils there, experienced a change-over only at the genus level, and the number of species remained the same.

acada97b112c.title: Triassic
acada97b112c.sentence: Some aetosaurs, the next most common tetrapods, and early dinosaurs, passed through unchanged.

3d56776b63e8.title: Jurassic
3d56776b63e8.sentence: Modern lissamphibians began to diversify during the Jurassic.

5606675536cd.title: Jurassic
5606675536cd.sentence: Other major events include the appearance of the earliest crabs and modern frogs, salamanders and lizards.

eef1a791069d.title: Triassic
eef1a791069d.sentence: However, the group as a whole did not become common until the Jurassic, when the temnospondyls had become very rare.

e14d99b52ade.title: Jurassic
e14d99b52ade.sentence: The stem-caecilian Eocaecilia is known from the Early Jurassic of Arizona.

ed295440c7d2.title: Jurassic
ed295440c7d2.sentence: Morphologically recognisable stem-frogs like the South American Notobatrachus are known from the Middle Jurassic, with modern crown-group frogs like Enneabatrachus and Rhadinosteus appearing by the Late Jurassic.

abf13a90f21e.title: Jurassic
abf13a90f21e.sentence: The fourth group of lissamphibians, the extinct salamander-like albanerpetontids, first appeared in the Middle Jurassic, represented by Anoualerpeton priscus from the Bathonian of Britain, as well as indeterminate remains from equivalently aged sediments in France and the Anoual Formation of Morocco.

1d59478e319b.title: Jurassic
1d59478e319b.sentence: The diversity of temnospondyls had progressively declined through the Late Triassic, with only brachyopoids surviving into the Jurassic and beyond.

fcf42cd76879.title: Jurassic
fcf42cd76879.sentence: The Jurassic also witnessed the decline of the Pangaean megamonsoon that had characterised the preceding Permian and Triassic periods.

78708d9a02b2.title: Jurassic
78708d9a02b2.sentence: Plesiosaurs were already diverse in the earliest Jurassic, with the majority of plesiosaurs in the Hettangian-aged Blue Lias belonging to the Rhomaleosauridae.

62cb7e781537.title: Jurassic
62cb7e781537.sentence: Plesiosaurs invaded freshwater environments during the Jurassic, with indeterminate remains of small-bodied pleisosaurs known from freshwater sediments from the Jurassic of China and Australia.

d3aca17e2889.title: Jurassic
d3aca17e2889.sentence: Early plesiosaurs were generally small-bodied, with body size increasing into the Toarcian.

8e439c812556.title: Jurassic
8e439c812556.sentence: Also abundant during the Jurassic is the extinct family Cheirolepidiaceae, often recognised through their highly distinctive Classopolis pollen.

c2a9e6b76b08.title: Jurassic
c2a9e6b76b08.sentence: Rhynchonellida and Terebratulida also declined during the Triassic–Jurassic extinction but rebounded during the Early Jurassic; neither clade underwent much morphological variation.

0a03f8d98503.title: Jurassic
0a03f8d98503.sentence: Tropical reef ecosystems collapsed during the event, and would not fully recover until much later in the Jurassic.

f4f78b568c3b.title: Jurassic
f4f78b568c3b.sentence: Ammonites explosively diversified during the Early Jurassic, with the orders Psiloceratina, Ammonitina, Lytoceratina, Haploceratina, Perisphinctina and Ancyloceratina all appearing during the Jurassic.

2820ccc667e5.title: Jurassic
2820ccc667e5.sentence: Ammonite faunas during the Jurassic were regional, being divided into around 20 distinguishable provinces and subprovinces in two realms, the northern high latitude Pan-Boreal realm, consisting of the Arctic, northern Panthalassa and northern Atlantic regions, and the equatorial–southern Pan-Tethyan realm, which included the Tethys and most of Panthalassa.

c04107fd2a0f.title: Jurassic
c04107fd2a0f.sentence: Basal neotheropods, such as coelophysoids and dilophosaurs, persisted into the Early Jurassic, but became extinct by the Middle Jurassic.

8d9c4eef183f.title: Jurassic
8d9c4eef183f.sentence: Basal bipedal sauropodomorphs, such as massospondylids, continued to exist into the Early Jurassic, but became extinct by the beginning of the Middle Jurassic.

729e20237c51.title: Jurassic
729e20237c51.sentence: The morphological diversity of crocodylomorphs during the Early Jurassic was around the same as that of Late Triassic pseudosuchians, but they occupied different areas of morphospace, suggesting that they occupied different ecological niches to their Triassic counterparts and that there was an extensive and rapid radiation of crocodylomorphs during this interval.

d3ce526f48fe.title: Jurassic
d3ce526f48fe.sentence: The Thalattosuchia, a clade of predominantly marine crocodylomorphs, first appeared during the Early Jurassic and became a prominent part of marine ecosystems.

aa5e4e6312dd.title: Jurassic
aa5e4e6312dd.sentence: Crocodylomorphs made the transition from a terrestrial to an aquatic life.

58d42560c957.title: Jurassic
58d42560c957.sentence: An unnamed protosuchid known from teeth from the Early Jurassic of Arizona represents the earliest known herbivorous crocodylomorph, an adaptation that appeared several times during the Mesozoic.

92463b6b56db.title: Jurassic
92463b6b56db.sentence: Dinosaurs, which had morphologically diversified in the Late Triassic, experienced a major increase in diversity and abundance during the Early Jurassic in the aftermath of the end-Triassic extinction and the extinction of other reptile groups, becoming the dominant vertebrates in terrestrial ecosystems.

12456c112cd9.title: History of Earth
12456c112cd9.sentence: The Triassic–Jurassic extinction event at 200 Ma spared many of the dinosaurs, and they soon became dominant among the vertebrates.

9c37e9c19a4b.title: History of life
9c37e9c19a4b.sentence: Dinosaurs distinguished themselves from other archosaurs in the Late Triassic, and became the dominant land vertebrates of the Jurassic and Cretaceous periods (201.4 to 66 Ma).

8bde282e17f4.title: Permian–Triassic extinction event
8bde282e17f4.sentence: In the mid to late Triassic, the dinosaurs evolved from one group of archosaurs, and went on to dominate terrestrial ecosystems during the Jurassic and Cretaceous.

0811e696e644.title: Jurassic
0811e696e644.sentence: The earliest definitive ornithischians appear during the Early Jurassic, represented by basal ornithischians like Lesothosaurus, heterodontosaurids, and early members of Thyreophora.

0ad147f58c2c.title: Jurassic
0ad147f58c2c.sentence: At the end of the Triassic, the Peltaspermaceae became extinct in most parts of the world, with Lepidopteris persisting into the Early Jurassic in Patagonia.

38da10b2cba8.title: Jurassic
38da10b2cba8.sentence: The Neoselachii, which contains all living sharks and rays, radiated beginning in the Early Jurassic.

2f287ebe4e9d.title: Jurassic
2f287ebe4e9d.sentence: Modern sharks and rays first appeared and diversified during the period, while the first known crown-group teleost fish (the dominant group of modern fish) appeared near the end of the period.

b147169ef16b.title: Jurassic
b147169ef16b.sentence: The oldest known ray (Batoidea) is Antiquaobatis from the Pliensbachian of Germany.

d4d434566d8d.title: Jurassic
d4d434566d8d.sentence: The oldest known Hexanchiformes and carpet sharks (Orectolobiformes) are from the Early Jurassic (Pliensbachian and Toarcian, respectively) of Europe.

4909d47baf47.title: Jurassic
4909d47baf47.sentence: During the Early Jurassic, the shark-like hybodonts, which represented the dominant group of chondrichthyans during the preceding Triassic, were common in both marine and freshwater settings; however, by the Late Jurassic, hybodonts had become minor components of most marine communities, having been largely replaced by modern neoselachians, but remained common in freshwater and restricted marine environments.

d514e7a1f38c.title: Jurassic
d514e7a1f38c.sentence: During the Early Jurassic the world's oceans transitioned from an aragonite sea to a calcite sea chemistry, favouring the dissolution of aragonite and precipitation of calcite.

56883126fe38.title: Jurassic
56883126fe38.sentence: Beginning in the Early Jurassic, the Boreal Ocean was connected to the proto-Atlantic by the "Viking corridor" or Transcontinental Laurasian Seaway, a passage between the Baltic Shield and Greenland several hundred kilometers wide.

a0e0710d6791.title: Geologic time scale
a0e0710d6791.sentence: Phanerozoic | Mesozoic | Jurassic | Upper/Late | Tithonian | Seafloor spreading in the Central Atlantic between North America and Africa-South America begins break up of Pangaea. Rifting continues in northern Atlantic and Caribbean. Gondwana splits into East and West Gondwana as Somali and Mozambique basins open. Pacific plate forms in central Panthalassa. Cimmerian and Indosinian orogenies continue. Start of Andean tectonic cycle, South America. Nevadan orogeny, North America. Mongol-Okhotsk Ocean closes forming Verkhoyansk - Kolyma mountain belt, Siberia. Neotethys narrows. Greenhouse climate with warmer and cooler periods. Arid conditions across equatorial and subtropical regions; coal and bauxite deposits in wetter temperate belts. Emplacement of Karoo-Ferrar LIP leads to global warming and the widespread Toarcian oceanic anoxic event. Rise in global sea levels. Change from aragonite to calcite seas. First large reefs. Phytoplankton and dinoflagellates diversify. First coccolithophores. Ammonoids and bellomnoids proliferate. Major radiation of sharks. Vieraella earliest true frog. First modern turtles. Cycads dominant forest flora. Also ferns, conifers and ginkgos. Dinosaurs rise to dominance, mammals remain small. First Ornithischia (e.g. stegasaurs and ceratopsians). Sauropods evolve into giants, including brachiosaurs, titanosaurs, and diplodocids. First ceratosaurs, megalosaurs, allosaurs, and coelurosaurs theropods. Coelurosaurs, many with feathers, include early tyrannosaurs and maniraptorans (ancestors of birds). First pterodactyloids. | 149.2 ± 0.7

a866c7211585.title: Jurassic
a866c7211585.sentence: The rise of calcareous plankton during the Middle Jurassic profoundly altered ocean chemistry, with the deposition of biomineralized plankton on the ocean floor acting as a buffer against large CO2 emissions.

0dbcd3d3ef7f.title: Jurassic
0dbcd3d3ef7f.sentence: The last known species of conodont, a class of jawless fish whose hard, tooth-like elements are key index fossils, finally became extinct during the earliest Jurassic after over 300 million years of evolutionary history, with an asynchronous extinction occurring first in the Tethys and eastern Panthalassa and survivors persisting into the earliest Hettangian of Hungary and central Panthalassa.

7e766f115d28.title: Jurassic
7e766f115d28.sentence: End-Triassic conodonts were represented by only a handful of species and had been progressively declining through the Middle and Late Triassic.

19dc872a9af0.title: Jurassic
19dc872a9af0.sentence: At the beginning of the Jurassic, all of the world's major landmasses were coalesced into the supercontinent Pangaea, which during the Early Jurassic began to break up into northern supercontinent Laurasia and the southern supercontinent Gondwana.

c128cbbd77a5.title: Late Jurassic
c128cbbd77a5.sentence: By the Late Jurassic, Pangaea had already broken apart into Laurasia (Eurasia and North America) to the north and Gondwana to the south, divided by the wide Tethys Ocean.

e04a71e142b5.title: Jurassic
e04a71e142b5.sentence: Thanks to the breakup of Pangaea, the hydrological cycle during the Jurassic was significantly enhanced.

ebdc46fe0cf2.title: Jurassic
ebdc46fe0cf2.sentence: At the beginning of the Jurassic, North and South America remained connected, but by the beginning of the Late Jurassic they had rifted apart to form the Caribbean Seaway, also known as the Hispanic Corridor, which connected the North Atlantic Ocean with eastern Panthalassa.

afc05e96a886.title: Jurassic
afc05e96a886.sentence: Palaeontological data suggest that the seaway had been open since the Early Jurassic.

fb06d6ebeed2.title: Jurassic
fb06d6ebeed2.sentence: Gravisaurian sauropods first appeared during the Early Jurassic, with the oldest definitive record being Vulcanodon from Zimbabwe, likely of Sinemurian age.

a3573f2576d3.title: Jurassic
a3573f2576d3.sentence: The quadrupedal Ledumahadi from the earliest Jurassic of South Africa reached an estimated weight of 12 tons, far in excess of other known basal sauropodomorphs.

fed0e1eb8d61.title: Jurassic
fed0e1eb8d61.sentence: Sauropods became the dominant large herbivores in terrestrial ecosystems during the Jurassic.

9820e358941c.title: Jurassic
9820e358941c.sentence: The eustatic sea level is estimated to have been close to present levels during the Hettangian and Sinemurian, rising several tens of metres during the late Sinemurian–Pliensbachian before regressing to near present levels by the late Pliensbachian.

eca192d58640.title: Jurassic
eca192d58640.sentence: The earliest averostrans appear during the Early Jurassic, with the earliest known member of Ceratosauria being Saltriovenator from the early Sinemurian (199.3–197.5 Ma) of Italy.

4ab0420fbe4c.title: Jurassic
4ab0420fbe4c.sentence: The first part of the Jurassic was marked by the Early Jurassic Cool Interval between 199 and 183 million years ago.

60f385a92ba0.title: Jurassic
60f385a92ba0.sentence: It has been proposed that glaciation was present in the Northern Hemisphere during both the early Pliensbachian and the latest Pliensbachian.

01cddddca2a8.title: Jurassic
01cddddca2a8.sentence: Dropstones and glendonites in northeastern Siberia during the Early to Middle Jurassic indicate cold winters.

3a92851c9eba.title: Jurassic
3a92851c9eba.sentence: There was a spike in global temperatures of around 4–8 °C (7–14 °F) during the early part of the Toarcian corresponding to the Toarcian Oceanic Anoxic Event and the eruption of the Karoo-Ferrar large igneous provinces in southern Gondwana, with the warm interval extending to the end of the Toarcian around 174 million years ago.

b9ef643b7272.title: Jurassic
b9ef643b7272.sentence: The impact has been dated to the Sinemurian, 195.9 ± 1.0 Ma.

b8a744ee8891.title: Jurassic
b8a744ee8891.sentence: Another major structure is the Puchezh-Katunki crater, 40 kilometres in diameter, buried beneath Nizhny Novgorod Oblast in western Russia.

9091037c9acd.title: Jurassic
9091037c9acd.sentence: The first true crabs (Brachyura) are known from the Early Jurassic, with the earliest being Eocarcinus praecursor from the early Pliensbachian of England, which lacked the crab-like morphology (carcinisation) of modern crabs, and Eoprosopon klugi from the late Pliensbachian of Germany, which may belong to the living family Homolodromiidae.

4595a5e05cac.title: Crustacean
4595a5e05cac.sentence: In the Decapoda, prawns and polychelids appear in the Triassic, and shrimp and crabs appear in the Jurassic.

6022ef6d391a.title: Jurassic
6022ef6d391a.sentence: During the Early Jurassic, around 190 million years ago, the Pacific Plate originated at the triple junction of the Farallon, Phoenix, and Izanagi tectonic plates, the three main oceanic plates of Panthalassa.

135a32167aeb.title: Jurassic
135a32167aeb.sentence: The previously stable triple junction had converted to an unstable arrangement surrounded on all sides by transform faults because of a kink in one of the plate boundaries, resulting in the formation of the Pacific Plate at the centre of the junction.

08f6d516db2a.title: Ring of Fire
08f6d516db2a.section: Tectonic plate configurations > Past plate configurations
08f6d516db2a.sentence: The Pacific plate came into existence in the Early Jurassic about 190 million years ago, far from the margins of the then Paleo-Pacific Ocean.

f3a6332f2df1.title: Mesozoic
f3a6332f2df1.sentence: On land, dinosaurs and other archosaurs staked their claim as the dominant race, with theropods such as Dilophosaurus at the top of the food chain.

40ca1937a3f2.title: Jurassic
40ca1937a3f2.section: Climate > Climatic events > Toarcian Oceanic Anoxic Event
40ca1937a3f2.sentence: The Toarcian Oceanic Anoxic Event (TOAE), also known as the Jenkyns Event, was an episode of widespread oceanic anoxia during the early part of the Toarcian Age, c. 183 Ma.

e0272978c3c5.title: Jurassic
e0272978c3c5.sentence: The beginning of the Toarcian Age started around 183 Ma and is marked by the Toarcian Oceanic Anoxic Event, a global episode of oceanic anoxia, ocean acidification, and elevated global temperatures associated with extinctions, likely caused by the eruption of the Karoo-Ferrar large igneous provinces.

1c2934bfc9e5.title: Jurassic
1c2934bfc9e5.sentence: During the Toarcian Warm Interval, ocean surface temperatures likely exceeded 30 °C (86 °F), and equatorial and subtropical (30°N–30°S) regions are likely to have been extremely arid, with temperatures in the interior of Pangea likely in excess of 40 °C (104 °F).The Toarcian Warm Interval is followed by the Middle Jurassic Cool Interval (MJCI) between 174 and 164 Ma, which may have been punctuated by brief, ephemeral icehouse intervals.

ef58e8d8f8a3.title: Jurassic
ef58e8d8f8a3.sentence: There seems to have been a gradual rise to a peak of ~75 m above present sea level during the Toarcian.

6e9c8eda600c.title: Jurassic
6e9c8eda600c.sentence: The rifting between North America and Africa was the first to initiate, beginning in the early Jurassic, associated with the emplacement of the Central Atlantic Magmatic Province.

b8e25afcebae.title: Cretaceous
b8e25afcebae.sentence: In the Jurassic, the North Atlantic already opened, leaving a proto-ocean between Europe and North America.

788c705c0175.title: Jurassic
788c705c0175.sentence: During the Jurassic, the North Atlantic Ocean remained relatively narrow, while the South Atlantic did not open until the Cretaceous.

785c51eef944.title: Oceanic crust
785c51eef944.sentence: The oldest large-scale oceanic crust is in the west Pacific and north-west Atlantic — both are about up to 180-200 million years old.

04273110a345.title: Paleomagnetism
04273110a345.sentence: The oldest rocks on the ocean floor are 200 Ma: very young when compared with the oldest continental rocks which date from 3.8 Ga.

807a134deae2.title: Jurassic
807a134deae2.sentence: Madagascar and Antarctica began to rift away from Africa during the late Early Jurassic in association with the eruption of the Karoo-Ferrar large igneous provinces, opening the western Indian Ocean and beginning the fragmentation of Gondwana.

05e898568149.title: Cretaceous
05e898568149.sentence: Gondwana had begun to break up during the Jurassic Period, but its fragmentation accelerated during the Cretaceous and was largely complete by the end of the period.

ccddcedeb619.title: Jurassic
ccddcedeb619.sentence: At the Early–Middle Jurassic boundary, between the end of the Toarcian and the beginning of the Bajocian, most lineages of ichythosaur appear to have become extinct, with the first appearance of the Ophthalmosauridae, the clade that would encompass almost all ichthyosaurs from then on, during the early Bajocian.

9a1d260c5229.title: Jurassic
9a1d260c5229.sentence: There appears to have been a strong turnover around the Early–Middle Jurassic boundary, with microcleidids and rhomaleosaurids becoming extinct and nearly extinct respectively after the end of the Toarcian with the first appearance of the dominant clade of plesiosaurs of the latter half of the Jurassic, the Cryptoclididae during the Bajocian.

9498091382db.title: Jurassic
9498091382db.sentence: The earliest representatives of the genus Ginkgo, represented by ovulate and pollen organs similar to those of the modern species, are known from the Middle Jurassic in the Northern Hemisphere.

69a72f55504b.title: Mesozoic
69a72f55504b.sentence: The earliest members of the genus Ginkgo first appeared during the Middle Jurassic.

65e96839788f.title: Jurassic
65e96839788f.sentence: Ginkgoales, of which the sole living species is Ginkgo biloba, were more diverse during the Jurassic: they were among the most important components of Eurasian Jurassic floras and were adapted to a wide variety of climatic conditions.

be220a3b2325.title: Jurassic
be220a3b2325.sentence: The earliest octopuses appeared during the Middle Jurassic, having split from their closest living relatives, the vampyromorphs, during the Triassic to Early Jurassic.

e9b0d13ec87d.title: Jurassic
e9b0d13ec87d.sentence: During the Middle to early Late Jurassic, the Sundance Seaway, a shallow epicontinental sea, covered much of northwest North America.

6f2efa7995bc.title: Jurassic
6f2efa7995bc.sentence: The oldest member of Allosauroidea has been suggested to be Asfaltovenator from the Middle Jurassic of South America.

30516f8ffd04.title: Jurassic
30516f8ffd04.sentence: Coelurosaurs first appeared during the Middle Jurassic, including early tyrannosaurs such as Proceratosaurus from the Bathonian of Britain.

72f2135e83a3.title: Jurassic
72f2135e83a3.sentence: It progressively rose from the Aalenian onwards, aside from dips of a few tens of metres in the Bajocian and around the Callovian–Oxfordian boundary, peaking possibly as high as 140 metres above present sea level at the Kimmeridgian–Tithonian boundary.

8c7853747901.title: Mesozoic
8c7853747901.sentence: Sea levels began to rise during the Jurassic, probably caused by an increase in seafloor spreading.

d3921854f14b.title: Jurassic
d3921854f14b.sentence: A transient ice age possibly occurred in the late Bajocian.

f024c9e1184f.title: Jurassic
f024c9e1184f.sentence: The European climate appears to have become noticeably more humid at the Aalenian-Bajocian boundary but then became more arid during the middle Bajocian.

ea522e0a9634.title: Jurassic
ea522e0a9634.sentence: The Callovian-Oxfordian boundary at the end of the MJCI witnessed particularly notable global cooling, potentially even an ice age.

6f1601296af0.title: Jurassic
6f1601296af0.sentence: The earliest members of Ankylosauria and Stegosauria appear during the Middle Jurassic.

bd361358f5d8.title: Jurassic
bd361358f5d8.sentence: The Megalosauridae represent the oldest radiation of the Tetanurae, first appearing in Europe during the Bajocian.

be01f83fe19f.title: Jurassic
be01f83fe19f.sentence: Early representatives of crown group salamanders include Chunerpeton, Pangerpeton and Linglongtriton from the Middle to Late Jurassic Yanliao Biota of China.

6aa7317a75fe.title: Jurassic
6aa7317a75fe.sentence: Salamanders dispersed into North America by the end of the Jurassic, as evidenced by Iridotriton, found in the Late Jurassic Morrison Formation.

5cfd63d91a60.title: Jurassic
5cfd63d91a60.sentence: Squamates first appear in the fossil record during the Middle Jurassic including members of modern clades such as Scincomorpha, though many Jurassic squamates have unclear relationships to living groups.

7f258bfd06aa.title: Jurassic
7f258bfd06aa.sentence: The last common ancestor of living squamates (which includes lizards and snakes) is estimated to have lived around 190 million years ago during the Early Jurassic, with the major divergences between modern squamate lineages estimated to have occurred during the Early to Middle Jurassic.

49e5bf120f41.title: Snake
49e5bf120f41.sentence: Snakes are thought to have evolved from either burrowing or aquatic lizards, perhaps during the Jurassic period, with the earliest known fossils dating to between 143 and 167 Ma ago.

a825343704f7.title: Jurassic
a825343704f7.sentence: Eichstaettisaurus from the Late Jurassic of Germany has been suggested to be an early relative of geckos and displays adaptations for climbing.

5293c9853bea.title: Jurassic
5293c9853bea.sentence: Dorsetisaurus from the Late Jurassic of North America and Europe represents the oldest widely accepted record of Anguimorpha.

04b0a7422287.title: Jurassic
04b0a7422287.sentence: The earliest known remains of Choristodera, a group of freshwater aquatic reptiles with uncertain affinities to other reptile groups, are found in the Middle Jurassic.

47b68d505ab1.title: Jurassic
47b68d505ab1.sentence: One is the small lizard-like Cteniogenys, thought to be the most basal known choristodere; it is known from the Middle to Late Jurassic of Europe and Late Jurassic of North America, with similar remains also known from the upper Middle Jurassic of Kyrgyzstan and western Siberia.

2824cc0a12fb.title: Miocene
2824cc0a12fb.sentence: The youngest representatives of Choristodera, an extinct order of aquatic reptiles that first appeared in the Middle Jurassic, are known from the Miocene of Europe, belonging to the genus Lazarussuchus, which had been the only known surviving genus of the group since the beginning of the Eocene.

9826fcd26e59.title: Jurassic
9826fcd26e59.sentence: The other is Coeruleodraco from the Late Jurassic of China, which is a more advanced choristodere, though still small and lizard-like in morphology.

3d4ac2025f87.title: Jurassic
3d4ac2025f87.sentence: The earliest records of multituberculates, one of the longest lasting and most successful orders of mammals, are known from the Middle Jurassic.

215ba0066efe.title: Oligocene
215ba0066efe.sentence: Multituberculates, an ancient lineage of primitive mammals that originated back in the Jurassic, also became extinct in the Oligocene, aside from the gondwanatheres.

d3b4823c98bf.title: Mammal
d3b4823c98bf.sentence: Ambondro is more closely related to monotremes than to therian mammals while Amphilestes and Amphitherium are more closely related to the therians; as fossils of all three genera are dated about 167 million years ago in the Middle Jurassic, this is a reasonable estimate for the appearance of the crown group.

8750e3b19899.title: History of life
8750e3b19899.sentence: However, fossil teeth discovered in Madagascar indicate that the split between the lineage leading to monotremes and the one leading to other living mammals had occurred by 167 Ma.

371733e31b70.title: Mammal
371733e31b70.sentence: Crown group mammals evolved from earlier mammaliaforms during the Early Jurassic.

924e9651f961.title: Jurassic
924e9651f961.sentence: Mammaliaformes, one of the few cynodont lineages to survive the end of the Triassic, continued to diversify throughout the period, with the Jurassic seeing the emergence of the first crown group mammals.

aedade115e91.title: Triassic
aedade115e91.sentence: However, the first stem-group mammals (mammaliamorphs), themselves a specialized subgroup of cynodonts, appeared during the Triassic and would survive the extinction event, allowing them to radiate during the Jurassic.

4bab694075a0.title: Tetrapod
4bab694075a0.sentence: During the Jurassic, one synapsid group (Cynodontia) gave rise to the modern mammals, which survived through the rest of the Mesozoic to later diversify during the Cenozoic.

598495aafab2.title: Mesozoic
598495aafab2.sentence: Meanwhile, an abundance of mammaliaforms appeared in the Jurassic with the first true mammals evolving, remaining relatively small, but spreading widely; the Jurassic Castorocauda, for example, had adaptations for swimming, digging and catching fish.

583d5dfb6923.title: Mesozoic
583d5dfb6923.sentence: Fruitafossor, from the late Jurassic Period about 150 Ma, was about the size of a chipmunk, and its teeth, forelimbs and back suggest that it dug open the nests of social insects (probably termites, as ants had not yet appeared); Volaticotherium was able to glide for short distances, such as modern flying squirrels.

e6535d12798c.title: Jurassic
e6535d12798c.sentence: During the Callovian, the Turgai Epicontinental Sea formed, creating a marine barrier between Europe and Asia.

adb7a3196716.title: Jurassic
adb7a3196716.sentence: This is followed by the Kimmeridgian Warm Interval (KWI) between 164 and 150 Ma.

6c786b24cdb6.title: Jurassic
6c786b24cdb6.sentence: Based on fossil wood distribution, this was one of the wettest intervals of the Jurassic.

c40969597c95.title: Jurassic
c40969597c95.sentence: The Pangaean interior had less severe seasonal swings than in previous warm periods as the expansion of the Central Atlantic and Western Indian Ocean provided new sources of moisture.

20b6fb594f88.title: Late Jurassic
20b6fb594f88.sentence: Europe became progressively more arid over the Late Jurassic.

651c0c4cead5.title: Jurassic
651c0c4cead5.sentence: During the Late Triassic and Jurassic, it is suggested that a number of terranes, including the West Burma Block, "Argoland" (a collection of terranes mostly part of modern Indonesia) and the Lhasa Terrane (now part of Tibet), rifted off the eastern margin of Gondwana (what is now northwest Australia and northern India) and subsequently drifted northwards before colliding with Asia during the Cretaceous and Cenozoic.

c94bd83bb83a.title: Jurassic
c94bd83bb83a.sentence: The two modern groups of turtles (Testudines), Pleurodira and Cryptodira, diverged by the beginning of the Late Jurassic.

ca9dffd9efae.title: Jurassic
ca9dffd9efae.sentence: The oldest known pleurodires, the Platychelyidae, are known from the Late Jurassic of Europe and the Americas, while the oldest unambiguous cryptodire, Sinaspideretes, an early relative of softshell turtles, is known from the Late Jurassic of China.

c63a15004b2d.title: Jurassic
c63a15004b2d.sentence: The Thalassochelydia, a diverse lineage of marine turtles unrelated to modern sea turtles, are known from the Late Jurassic of Europe and South America.

1149155e8efd.title: Jurassic
1149155e8efd.sentence: The Kimmeridge Clay and equivalents are the major source rock for the North Sea oil.

1dbabd931f00.title: Jurassic
1dbabd931f00.sentence: The Jurassic-aged Sargelu and Naokelekan formations are major source rocks for oil in Iraq.

5ebd904e7af0.title: Jurassic
5ebd904e7af0.sentence: The Arabian Intrashelf Basin, deposited during the Middle and Late Jurassic, is the setting of the world's largest oil reserves, including the Ghawar Field, the world's largest oil field.

fb8870564b4c.title: Jurassic
fb8870564b4c.sentence: By the Middle Jurassic the Siberian plate and the North China-Amuria block had collided, resulting in the closure of the Mongol-Okhotsk Ocean.

d222034264f0.title: Jurassic
d222034264f0.sentence: Having declined at the Triassic–Jurassic boundary, reefs substantially expanded during the Late Jurassic, including both sponge reefs and scleractinian coral reefs.

868180f415ac.title: Jurassic
868180f415ac.sentence: Late Jurassic reefs were similar in form to modern reefs but had more microbial carbonates and hypercalcified sponges, and had weak biogenic binding.

0b98e23a76d1.title: Jurassic
0b98e23a76d1.sentence: While rare in the Early and Middle Jurassic, crabs became abundant during the Late Jurassic as they expanded from their ancestral silty sea floor habitat into hard substrate habitats like reefs, with crevices in reefs providing refuge from predators.

55c9b32624ec.title: Jurassic
55c9b32624ec.sentence: The oldest known representatives of anatomically modern gars appeared during the Late Jurassic.

6dc7ea0da0ca.title: Jurassic
6dc7ea0da0ca.sentence: Ceratopsians first appeared in the Late Jurassic of China, represented by members of Chaoyangsauridae.

1ccb5a9c3bc3.title: Mammal
1ccb5a9c3bc3.sentence: The oldest-known fossil among the Eutheria ("true beasts") is the small shrewlike Juramaia sinensis, or "Jurassic mother from China", dated to 160 million years ago in the late Jurassic.

712623e3fdbc.title: Jurassic
712623e3fdbc.sentence: They have their earliest records during the early Late Jurassic, represented by Juramaia, a eutherian mammal closer to the ancestry of placentals than marsupials.

b016ff1518ca.title: Late Jurassic
b016ff1518ca.sentence: During the Late Jurassic, narrow ocean basins formed separating Eastern Gondwana (Antarctica, Australia, India and Madagascar), Western Gondwana (Africa, Arabia and South America) and Laurasia.

56f30f8261f4.title: Cretaceous
56f30f8261f4.sentence: As the Atlantic Ocean widened, the convergent-margin mountain building (orogenies) that had begun during the Jurassic continued in the North American Cordillera, as the Nevadan orogeny was followed by the Sevier and Laramide orogenies.

c055dc2e4da6.title: Jurassic
c055dc2e4da6.sentence: The oldest unambiguous record of Pinaceae is the pine cone Eathiestrobus, known from the Late Jurassic (Kimmeridgian) of Scotland, which remains the only known unequivocal fossil of the group before the Cretaceous.

857fdc8affdc.title: Jurassic
857fdc8affdc.sentence: The Late Triassic and Jurassic was a major time of diversification of conifers, with most modern conifer groups appearing in the fossil record by the end of the Jurassic, having evolved from voltzialean ancestors.

a18e11dec85e.title: History of Earth
a18e11dec85e.sentence: The boundary between avian and non-avian dinosaurs is unclear, but Archaeopteryx, traditionally considered one of the first birds, lived around 150 Ma.

f7b929f29a24.title: Jurassic
f7b929f29a24.sentence: The first stem-group birds appeared during the Jurassic, evolving from a branch of theropod dinosaurs.

9561f52f0344.title: Mesozoic
9561f52f0344.sentence: Archaic birds appeared in the Jurassic, having evolved from a branch of theropod dinosaurs, then true toothless birds appeared in the Cretaceous.

022a98a7804e.title: Vertebrate
022a98a7804e.sentence: During the Triassic, mammals and dinosaurs appeared, the latter giving rise to birds in the Jurassic.

ab19628c6537.title: History of life
ab19628c6537.sentence: During the Late Jurassic, birds evolved from small, predatory theropod dinosaurs.

e709e2eb12b5.title: Mesozoic
e709e2eb12b5.sentence: During the Late Jurassic (161.5 to 143.1 Ma) the first avialans, such as Archaeopteryx, evolved from small coelurosaurian dinosaurs.

498dfbfbb410.title: Tetrapod
498dfbfbb410.sentence: Birds, a particular subset of theropod dinosaurs capable of flight via feathered wings, evolved in the Late Jurassic.

bc6fb00d6bfc.title: Bird
bc6fb00d6bfc.sentence: Birds are descendants of the primitive avialans (whose members include Archaeopteryx) which first appeared during the Late Jurassic.

a8dd9e798107.title: Jurassic
a8dd9e798107.sentence: The earliest avialans, which include birds and their ancestors, appear during the Middle to Late Jurassic, definitively represented by Archaeopteryx from the Late Jurassic of Germany.

3fe85d48f97d.title: Late Jurassic
3fe85d48f97d.sentence: Other animals, such as some crocodylomorphs and the first birds, appeared in the Jurassic.

3741b80fa88c.title: Jurassic
3741b80fa88c.sentence: The end of the Jurassic was marked by the Tithonian–early Barremian Cool Interval (TBCI), beginning 150 Ma and continuing into the Early Cretaceous.

1ad84f2728a6.title: Jurassic
1ad84f2728a6.sentence: A prominent drop in temperatures occurred during the Tithonian, known as the Early Tithonian Cooling Event (ETCE).

ad1cf473c933.title: Jurassic
ad1cf473c933.sentence: The impact is dated to the Tithonian, approximately 146.06 ± 0.16 Ma.

1e590b4ec356.title: Jurassic
1e590b4ec356.sentence: The end-Jurassic transition was originally considered one of eight mass extinctions, but is now considered to be a complex interval of faunal turnover, with the increase in diversity of some groups and decline in others, though the evidence for this is primarily European, probably controlled by changes in eustatic sea level.

e3a0bccf9c70.title: Extinction risk from climate change

e3a0bccf9c70.sentence: This was defined by the paper as a minor mass extinction, comparable to the end-Guadalupian and Jurassic–Cretaceous boundary events.

f8dc9c7059e1.title: Jurassic
f8dc9c7059e1.sentence: The sea levels falls in the late Tithonian, perhaps to around 100 metres, before rebounding to around 110 metres at the Tithonian–Berriasian boundary.

c28a1bdd7f40.title: Jurassic
c28a1bdd7f40.sentence: Reefs sharply declined at the close of the Jurassic, which caused an associated drop in diversity in decapod crustaceans.

a9a7a10623aa.title: Jurassic
a9a7a10623aa.sentence: The upper boundary of the Jurassic is currently undefined, and the Jurassic–Cretaceous boundary is currently the only system boundary to lack a defined GSSP.

5f30fdcf2958.title: Jurassic
5f30fdcf2958.sentence: The end of the Jurassic, however, has no clear, definitive boundary with the Cretaceous and is the only boundary between geological periods to remain formally undefined.

27355fc80f29.title: Cretaceous
27355fc80f29.sentence: The Cretaceous was named for the extensive chalk deposits of this age in Europe, but in many parts of the world, the deposits from the Cretaceous are of marine limestone, a rock type that is formed under warm, shallow marine conditions.

75cbce537d52.title: Cretaceous
75cbce537d52.sentence: It consists of coccoliths, microscopically small calcite skeletons of coccolithophores, a type of algae that prospered in the Cretaceous seas.

d5ec75a825a1.title: Cretaceous
d5ec75a825a1.sentence: In northwestern Europe, chalk deposits from the Upper Cretaceous are characteristic for the Chalk Group, which forms the white cliffs of Dover on the south coast of England and similar cliffs on the French Normandian coast.

9c31deffc13f.title: Cenozoic
9c31deffc13f.sentence: In the Cretaceous, the climate was hot and humid with lush forests at the poles, there was no permanent ice and sea levels were around 300 metres higher than today.

3ab21efc0f11.title: Cretaceous
3ab21efc0f11.sentence: During the Cretaceous, the late-Paleozoic-to-early-Mesozoic supercontinent of Pangaea completed its tectonic breakup into the present-day continents, although their positions were substantially different at the time.

a60965b43fb9.title: Mollusca
a60965b43fb9.sentence: One bivalve group, the rudists, became major reef-builders in the Cretaceous, but became extinct in the Cretaceous–Paleogene extinction event.

a3c7729bd977.title: Cretaceous
a3c7729bd977.sentence: The Cretaceous (IPA: /krɪˈteɪʃəs/ krih-TAY-shəss) is a geological period that lasted from about 143.1 to 66 Ma (million years ago).

1e7883206584.title: Jurassic
1e7883206584.sentence: The Jurassic (/dʒʊˈræsɪk/ juurr-ASS-ik) is a geologic period and stratigraphic system that lasted about 58.3 million years, spanning from the end of the Triassic Period 201.4 Ma (million years ago) to the beginning of the Cretaceous Period, 143.1 Ma.

e5c3e0452fc9.title: Cretaceous
e5c3e0452fc9.sentence: The lower boundary of the Cretaceous is currently undefined, and the Jurassic–Cretaceous boundary is currently the only system boundary to lack a defined Global Boundary Stratotype Section and Point (GSSP).

42c7a033bbae.title: Cretaceous
42c7a033bbae.sentence: In particular, the first appearance Calpionella alpina, coinciding with the base of the eponymous Alpina subzone, has been proposed as the definition of the base of the Cretaceous.

664cb2b2386c.title: Jurassic
664cb2b2386c.sentence: Calpionellids, an enigmatic group of planktonic protists with urn-shaped calcitic tests briefly abundant during the latest Jurassic to earliest Cretaceous, have been suggested to represent the most promising candidates for fixing the Jurassic–Cretaceous boundary In particular, the first appearance Calpionella alpina, co-inciding with the base of the eponymous Alpina subzone, has been proposed as the definition of the base of the Cretaceous.

08bd80c32bfa.title: Cretaceous
08bd80c32bfa.sentence: 143.1 ± 0.6 – 66.0 Ma PreꞒ Ꞓ O S D C P T J K Pg N

bfa7614a5343.title: Jurassic
bfa7614a5343.sentence: Tooth remains suggested to represent those of dromaeosaurs are known from the Jurassic, but no body remains are known until the Cretaceous.

608a38251974.title: Bird
608a38251974.sentence: Avialans diversified into a wide variety of forms during the Cretaceous period.

af16955c7a4f.title: History of life
af16955c7a4f.sentence: The first birds inherited teeth and long, bony tails from their dinosaur ancestors, but some had developed horny, toothless beaks by the very Late Jurassic and short pygostyle tails by the Early Cretaceous.

e847cf4bad56.title: Bird
e847cf4bad56.section: Evolution and classification > Early diversity of bird ancestors
e847cf4bad56.sentence: While they were the dominant group of avialans during the Cretaceous period, Enantiornithes became extinct along with many other dinosaur groups at the end of the Mesozoic era.

31246cb232c9.title: History of life
31246cb232c9.sentence: Social termites and ants first appeared in the Early Cretaceous, and advanced social bees have been found in Late Cretaceous rocks but did not become abundant until the Middle Cenozoic.

594ca876236e.title: Cretaceous
594ca876236e.sentence: Insects diversified during the Cretaceous, and the oldest known ants, termites and some lepidopterans, akin to butterflies and moths, appeared.

a82d4529b213.title: Cretaceous
a82d4529b213.sentence: The North Atlantic seaway opened and enabled the flow of cool water from the Boreal Ocean into the Tethys.

0405cfd6ef73.title: Cretaceous
0405cfd6ef73.sentence: The cooling trend of the last epoch of the Jurassic, the Tithonian, continued into the Berriasian, the first age of the Cretaceous.

7c656ad4b883.title: Cretaceous
7c656ad4b883.sentence: There is evidence that snowfalls were common in the higher latitudes during this age, and the tropics became wetter than during the Triassic and Jurassic.

211d77e730c2.title: Ice age
211d77e730c2.sentence: Geologic and palaeoclimatological records suggest the existence of glacial periods during the Valanginian, Hauterivian, and Aptian stages of the Early Cretaceous.

d08e9a7cd1a4.title: Ice age
d08e9a7cd1a4.sentence: Although the Mesozoic Era retained a greenhouse climate over its timespan and was previously assumed to have been entirely glaciation-free, more recent studies suggest that brief periods of glaciation occurred in both hemispheres during the Early Cretaceous.

f222d23bb896.title: Ice age
f222d23bb896.sentence: Ice-rafted glacial dropstones indicate that in the Northern Hemisphere, ice sheets may have extended as far south as the Iberian Peninsula during the Hauterivian and Aptian.

aa2daab399ba.title: Cretaceous
aa2daab399ba.sentence: The HTE marked the ultimate end of the Tithonian-early Barremian Cool Interval (TEBCI).

368cf870a8cc.title: Cretaceous
368cf870a8cc.sentence: - It was followed by the middle Hauterivian Faraoni Thermal Excursion and the early Barremian Hauptblatterton Thermal Event (HTE).

66441e6b7c86.title: Cretaceous
66441e6b7c86.sentence: Rafting by ice of stones into marine environments occurred during much of the Cretaceous, but evidence of deposition directly from glaciers is limited to the Early Cretaceous of the Eromanga Basin in southern Australia.

e221e5ab0866.title: Cretaceous
e221e5ab0866.sentence: - After the end of the first age, however, temperatures began to increase again, with a number of thermal excursions, such as the middle Valanginian Weissert Thermal Excursion, which was caused by the Paraná-Etendeka Large Igneous Province's activity.

9ca5346475b0.title: Cretaceous
9ca5346475b0.sentence: The Liaoning lagerstätte (Yixian Formation) in China is an important site, full of preserved remains of numerous types of small dinosaurs, birds and mammals, that provides a glimpse of life in the Early Cretaceous.

0412d878b39c.title: Cretaceous
0412d878b39c.sentence: The earliest widely accepted evidence of flowering plants are monosulcate (single-grooved) pollen grains from the late Valanginian (~ 134 Ma) found in Israel and Italy, initially at low abundance.

500e2a9d5f84.title: Cretaceous
500e2a9d5f84.sentence: During the Early Cretaceous, flowering plants appeared and began to rapidly diversify, becoming the dominant group of plants across the Earth by the end of the Cretaceous, coincident with the decline and extinction of previously widespread gymnosperm groups.

9d7d09d758f4.title: Mesozoic
9d7d09d758f4.sentence: Flowering plants appeared in the Early Cretaceous and would rapidly diversify through the end of the era, replacing conifers and other gymnosperms (sensu lato), such as ginkgoales, cycads and bennettitales as the dominant group of plants.

83a1ac66ee25.title: Cretaceous
83a1ac66ee25.sentence: Among the oldest records of Angiosperm macrofossils are Montsechia from the Barremian aged Las Hoyas beds of Spain and Archaefructus from the Barremian-Aptian boundary Yixian Formation in China.

8f466205c776.title: Cretaceous
8f466205c776.sentence: Tricolpate pollen distinctive of eudicots first appears in the Late Barremian, while the earliest remains of monocots are known from the Aptian.

a86cc51876df.title: Mesozoic
a86cc51876df.sentence: Flowering plants radiated during the Early Cretaceous, first in the tropics, but the even temperature gradient allowed them to spread toward the poles throughout the period.

724070887029.title: Mammal
724070887029.sentence: The earliest-known fossil of the Metatheria ("changed beasts") is Sinodelphys, found in 125-million-year-old Early Cretaceous shale in China's northeastern Liaoning Province.

da407b17a1f8.title: Mammal
da407b17a1f8.sentence: A later eutherian relative, Eomaia, dated to 125 million years ago in the early Cretaceous, possessed some features in common with the marsupials but not with the placentals, evidence that these features were present in the last common ancestor of the two groups but were later lost in the placental lineage.

3712e8f11c13.title: Mammal
3712e8f11c13.sentence: The parasagittal (nonsprawling) limb posture appeared sometime in the late Jurassic or early Cretaceous; it is found in the eutherian Eomaia and the metatherian Sinodelphys, both dated to 125 million years ago.

8f2f3137396e.title: Jurassic
8f2f3137396e.sentence: Juramaia is much more advanced than expected for its age, as other therian mammals are not known until the Early Cretaceous, and it has been suggested that Juramaia may also originate from the Early Cretaceous instead.

8b96a6e753c2.title: History of life
8b96a6e753c2.sentence: There is fossil evidence that flowering plants diversified rapidly in the Early Cretaceous, from 130 to 90 Ma, and that their rise was associated with that of pollinating insects.

b43dc3f8c668.title: Cretaceous
b43dc3f8c668.sentence: Flowering plants underwent a rapid radiation beginning during the middle Cretaceous, becoming the dominant group of land plants by the end of the period, coincident with the decline of previously dominant groups such as conifers.

ce1514b23fda.title: Cretaceous
ce1514b23fda.sentence: High temperatures fueling massive storms, hurricanes, and wildfires caused damages to trees.

66d1983f651d.title: Cretaceous
66d1983f651d.sentence: This along with arthropod damage caused trees during this time to produce large amounts of resin leading to the Cretaceous Resinous Interval lasting from 125 to 75 million years ago.

eb30d355913a.title: Triassic
eb30d355913a.sentence: The Triassic survivors were aquatic or semi-aquatic, and were represented by Tupilakosaurus, Thabanchuia, Branchiosauridae and Micropholis, all of which died out in Early Triassic, and the successful Stereospondyli, with survivors into the Cretaceous Period.

bfd353a3ffc4.title: Tetrapod
bfd353a3ffc4.sentence: By the Late Cretaceous, the only surviving amphibians were lissamphibians.

7a6549e92599.title: Mesozoic
7a6549e92599.sentence: The Early Cretaceous (143.1 to 100.5 Ma) saw the expansion of seaways and a decline in diversity of sauropods, stegosaurs, and other high-browsing groups.

489a9fcbc1c1.title: Mammal
489a9fcbc1c1.sentence: One of the earliest-known monotremes was Teinolophos, which lived about 120 million years ago in Australia.

60ee546c0b50.sentence: - The BAWI itself was followed by the Aptian-Albian Cold Snap (AACS) that began about 118 Ma.

586669f9be65.sentence: Temperatures increased drastically after the end of the AACS, which ended around 111 Ma with the Paquier/Urbino Thermal Maximum, giving way to the Mid-Cretaceous Hothouse (MKH), which lasted from the early Albian until the early Campanian.

0dd8ee1bbba1.title: Ring of Fire

1dbc7440fa98.sentence: At about 120 to 115 million years ago, the Farallon plate was subducting under South America, North America and north-east Asia while the Izanagi plate was subducting under east Asia.

6a34468c5052.sentence: The oldest known fossils of grasses are from the Albian, with the family having diversified into modern groups by the end of the Cretaceous.

db621de06980.title: Snake

f5b08d22fcf3.title: Snake

8e034eaf36d5.title: Snake
8e034eaf36d5.sentence: An alternative hypothesis, based on morphology, suggests the ancestors of snakes were related to mosasaurs—extinct aquatic reptiles from the Cretaceous—forming the clade Pythonomorpha.

0d810508398d.title: Snake
0d810508398d.sentence: In the Late Cretaceous, snakes recolonized land, and continued to diversify into today's snakes.

a679d27df8c7.sentence: - The Leenhardt Thermal Event occurred around 110 Ma, followed shortly by the l'Arboudeyesse Thermal Event a million years later.

dfedc2c4635c.title: Arachnid
dfedc2c4635c.sentence: A fossil arachnid in 100 million year old (mya) amber from Myanmar, Chimerarachne yingi, has spinnerets (to produce silk); it also has a tail, like the Palaeozoic Uraraneida, some 200 million years after other known fossils with tails.

3c938ead3b1a.title: Miocene

38b1d892ce19.title: Bird
38b1d892ce19.sentence: According to some estimates, modern birds (Neornithes) evolved in the Late Cretaceous or between the Early and Late Cretaceous (100 Ma) and diversified dramatically around the time of the Cretaceous–Paleogene extinction event 66 million years ago, which killed off the pterosaurs and all non-ornithuran dinosaurs.

93e92829d115.title: Bird

93e92829d115.sentence: However, a 2015 estimate that used a new method for calibrating molecular clocks confirmed that while modern birds originated early in the Late Cretaceous, likely in Western Gondwana, a pulse of diversification in all major groups occurred around the Cretaceous–Palaeogene extinction event.

dce78db37866.title: Bird

dce78db37866.sentence: Most studies agree on a Cretaceous age for the most recent common ancestor of modern birds but estimates range from the Early Cretaceous to the latest Cretaceous.

d6bcd6059879.title: Bird

d513da1646db.title: Bird

65523f21fa30.title: Cretaceous

96a0440cb324.title: Mesozoic

bc326e7a0519.title: Cretaceous
bc326e7a0519.sentence: - Approximately 94 Ma, the Cenomanian-Turonian Thermal Maximum occurred, with this hyperthermal being the most extreme hothouse interval of the Cretaceous and being associated with a sea level highstand.

74db407ec0c4.title: Cretaceous
74db407ec0c4.sentence: Tropical SSTs during the Cenomanian-Turonian Thermal Maximum were at least 30 °C, though one study estimated them as high as between 33 and 42 °C.

b19fb1a0069c.title: Cretaceous
b19fb1a0069c.sentence: Such hot temperatures during the MKH resulted in a very gentle temperature gradient from the equator to the poles; the latitudinal temperature gradient during the Cenomanian-Turonian Thermal Maximum was 0.54 °C per ° latitude for the Southern Hemisphere and 0.49 °C per ° latitude for the Northern Hemisphere, in contrast to present day values of 1.07 and 0.69 °C per ° latitude for the Southern and Northern hemispheres, respectively.

0bb1767acc57.title: Ice age
0bb1767acc57.sentence: Although ice sheets largely disappeared from Earth for the rest of the period (potential reports from the Turonian, otherwise the warmest period of the Phanerozoic, are disputed), ice sheets and associated sea ice appear to have briefly returned to Antarctica near the very end of the Maastrichtian just prior to the Cretaceous-Paleogene extinction event.

2dd372bcf264.title: Cretaceous
2dd372bcf264.sentence: It was suggested that there was Antarctic marine glaciation in the Turonian Age, based on isotopic evidence.

7b40ffb19e38.title: Cretaceous
7b40ffb19e38.sentence: Marine reptiles included ichthyosaurs in the early and mid-Cretaceous (becoming extinct during the late Cretaceous Cenomanian-Turonian anoxic event), plesiosaurs throughout the entire period, and mosasaurs appearing in the Late Cretaceous.

fb50e4fc499e.title: Cretaceous
fb50e4fc499e.sentence: - Temperatures cooled down slightly over the next few million years, but then another thermal maximum, the Coniacian Thermal Maximum, happened, with this thermal event being dated to around 87 Ma.
